title: Node and Edge Data Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Networks; Knowledge Representation
description: Interactive vis-network concept map of eight Chapter 8 concepts in which learners add nodes, connect them with labeled relationships, swap edge directions, drag nodes and switch between fixed and physics layouts while a panel shows the JSON data of the selected node or edge.

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: Node and edge data for concept maps
learningObjectives: The learner will implement a small concept map by editing node and edge data and observing how each change alters the drawn network.
prerequisites: Graph vocabulary: nodes, edges, directed edges
Node and edge data fields from Chapter 8

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Hands-on implementation with immediate visual feedback
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Edit data, observe drawing, inspect JSON
keyQuestions: Which field decides where an arrow points?
When is a fixed layout better than a physics layout?
commonMisconceptions: Edge direction is cosmetic and can be reversed without changing meaning.
A physics layout gives the same picture every time without a seed.
assessmentOpportunities: Add an edge from a written sentence with the correct from, to and label
Compare fixed and physics layouts for small and large graphs
